before_snippet:
from alembic import op
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer
from sqlalchemy.schema import Table, MetaData
import tempfile
import os
from alembic.migration import MigrationContext
from alembic.operations import Operations

# Simulate migration context
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    db_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'test.db')
    url = f'sqlite:///{db_path}'
    ctx = MigrationContext.configure(url)
    op_obj = Operations(ctx)
    
    # In 1.18.3, add_column with primary_key=True would render PRIMARY KEY inline
    # Create table first
    op_obj.create_table('test_table', Column('id', Integer, primary_key=True))
    
    # Now try to add another primary key column - in 1.18.3 this rendered inline
    # We verify the behavior by checking SQL generation doesn't fail
    col = Column('id2', Integer, primary_key=True)
    op_obj.add_column('test_table', col)
    # In 1.18.4, this will fail or produce different SQL without inline_primary_key param
    assert True
title: Operations.add_column() no longer renders PRIMARY KEY inline by default
